# M10 The Quiet Pass (FOG; province: Comet Pass, Yellow Comet's mountain march): the Aurean legion lands on the south plain, crosses the Quiet river at three bridges, climbs a pass road (west x7, centre x16, east x28) or the goat track (foot only, far west x1..3) through the massif (y5..13) and takes Kanbei's summit HQ '2' (16,2); Sonja's HQ '3' (31,3) sits in a pocket of the east ridge, off the east pass road. Threat/answer: ambushes at the pass tops in the fog -> Recons (vision) and the B Copter/T Copter scout ahead, the APC and Infantry hold the bridge heads; Tanks/Md Tanks at the pass tops (vehicles must use the roads) -> Mechs and Infantry on the goat track and over the mountains flank them, MDT and ART on the road below; Artillery + Rockets on the summit (hold) -> Recon sight, B Copter, Infantry/Mech over the mountains out of the roads' line; Sonja's Copter -> own AA. Player start: INF4 MECH3 TANK2 MDT2 RECON3 ART2 BCO1 TCO1 AA1 APC1 (19 units), 1 base, funds 4000. Kanbei: INF4 MECH2 TANK3 MDT2 ART2 ROCK1 AA1 (15); MECH x2, ART x2 and ROCK hold on the summit. Sonja: INF2 RECON2 TANK2 BCO1 (7), INF hold the pocket. Enemy about 1.2x the player's value.
# hq1: (16, 23) player HQ (south)
# base1: (13, 22) player base
# hq2: (16, 2) Kanbei's summit HQ: the objective
# hq3: (31, 3) Sonja's HQ in the east-ridge pocket
# gorge: (0, 15) river falling east: (0..10,15), (10..24,17), (24..33,19); bridges at (7,15) west, (16,17) centre, (28,19) east
# pass_w: (7, 10) west pass road (bridge (7,15) -> (7,4)), mountains either side
# pass_c: (15, 9) centre pass road (bridge (16,17) -> (16,4))
# pass_e: (26, 9) east pass road (bridge (28,19) -> (24,4)), with a spur east to Sonja's pocket at (29,3)
# goat_start: (1, 15) goat track foot start (plain landing north of the gorge)
# goat_end: (3, 4) goat track top: plain landing in the north forest, west of Kanbei's ground
# scene_day4: (17, 5) Kanbei's honour scene (day 4): the summit road's top, by the central pass
# sonja_ridge: (31, 3) east ridge mountains around Sonja's pocket x30..32, y2..4
